topic: How Google Maps Knows About Traffic (story first)

lines.say: In twenty twenty, an artist in Berlin faked a Google Maps traffic jam with a little red wagon.
lines.show: In 2020, an artist in Berlin *faked* a Google Maps *traffic jam* with a little [red wagon.]

lines.say: He loaded it with ninety-nine phones and slowly pulled them down an empty street.
lines.show: He loaded it with *99 phones* and slowly pulled them down an [empty street.]

lines.say: Google Maps turned that street red. A traffic jam made of phones, not cars.
lines.show: Google Maps turned that street *red.* A traffic jam made of [phones, not cars.]

lines.say: Because there's no camera watching that road. Maps is reading the phones inside the cars.
lines.show: Because there's *no camera* watching that road. Maps is reading the [phones inside the cars.]

lines.say: Phones navigating with Google Maps can share where they are and how fast they're moving. Maps combines them, like dots moving along each road.
lines.show: Phones navigating with Google Maps can share where they are and *how fast* they're moving. Maps combines them, like [dots moving along each road.]

lines.say: When lots of dots on one road slow right down, Maps marks that stretch red, and sends you around the jam.
lines.show: When lots of dots on one road *slow right down,* Maps marks that stretch red, and [sends you around the jam.]

lines.say: So next time you're stuck in traffic, look at that red line. Your phone is helping draw it.
lines.show: So next time you're stuck in traffic, look at that red line. [Your phone is helping draw it.]
